# Topic Desk Studio v0.1.0

The first public desktop release of [Topic Desk Studio](https://github.com/microai-lab/topic-desk-studio), a standalone desktop edition of [dsh-topic-desk](https://github.com/microai-lab/dsh-topic-desk). It runs independently of DeepSeek Harness and keeps its workspace in a local SQLite database.

## Highlights

- Collect trending topics from 49 built-in public sources.
- Search and filter by source, region, category, keyword, and ranking signals.
- Track rank movement, first-seen time, consecutive appearances, and trend history.
- Save promising topics to a persistent local creation queue.
- Enable or disable individual sources and inspect collection health without one failed source blocking the others.
- Optionally translate titles through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- Store API keys in the operating system credential vault rather than the application database.
- Open external articles safely in the system browser.

## Downloads

| Platform | Package |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `x64.dmg` |
| Windows x64 | `.msi` or `.exe` installer |
| Linux x64 | `.AppImage`, `.deb`, or `.rpm` |

## Installation notice

This initial release is not code-signed or notarized. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen may therefore display a warning. Only download installers from this repository's official Releases page. Linux credential storage requires a Secret Service provider such as GNOME Keyring or KDE Wallet.

# Topic Desk Studio v0.1.0 中文说明

这是 [Topic Desk Studio](https://github.com/microai-lab/topic-desk-studio) 的首个公开桌面版本，也是 [dsh-topic-desk](https://github.com/microai-lab/dsh-topic-desk) 的独立桌面版。应用无需 DeepSeek Harness 即可运行，并使用本机 SQLite 保存工作数据。

## 主要功能

- 内置 49 个公开热点来源。
- 支持按来源、地区、分类、关键词和排名信号检索与筛选。
- 展示排名变化、首次发现时间、连续上榜轮次和趋势历史。
- 将有价值的话题保存到本地持久化创作队列。
- 可独立启停来源并查看采集健康状态，单个来源失败不会阻塞其他来源。
- 可通过 OpenAI-compatible 接口翻译标题。
- API Key 保存在操作系统凭据库中，不写入应用数据库。
- 外部文章统一使用系统浏览器安全打开。

## 下载选择

| 平台 | 安装包 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `x64.dmg` |
| Windows x64 | `.msi` 或 `.exe` 安装程序 |
| Linux x64 | `.AppImage`、`.deb` 或 `.rpm` |

## 安装提示

首个版本尚未进行代码签名或 macOS 公证，因此 macOS Gatekeeper 或 Windows SmartScreen 可能显示安全提醒。请只从本仓库官方 Releases 页面下载安装包。Linux 的凭据存储需要 GNOME Keyring、KDE Wallet 等 Secret Service 服务。
